title: Quant Precision Checker: automated validation harness for FP8/INT8 calibration
creator: Priya Menon
description: Build an automated validation harness (Quant Precision Checker) that runs post-calibration FP8 and INT8 model variants through a curated golden prompt suite, computes robust delta metrics against a floating-point baseline, and outputs actionable pass/fail gating decisions for CI and canary rollouts.
rationale: As we expand FP8 and INT8 profiles for more models, manual checks and ad-hoc scripts are failing to catch subtle regressions across instruction-following and safety-sensitive prompts. We need a repeatable, auditable, and CI-friendly system that codifies pass/fail criteria and surfaces regressions early in the deployment pipeline.
proposed_solution: Implement a harness service and CI job that: (1) pulls the latest calibrated quant artifacts, (2) executes the golden prompt suite with deterministic seeds and model-specific sampling settings, (3) computes a battery of string- and embedding-based metrics (exact token delta, ROUGE-like overlap, embedding cosine drift, logprob distribution shift), (4) runs statistical significance and safety checks, and (5) emits a gating verdict (PASS/WARN/FAIL) with a detailed report and suggested rollback action. Harness will persist reports to S3 and emit Slack/GitHub status checks.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Harness runs end-to-end in CI for a sample model and completes within SLAs (90% runs < 30m). 2) Report includes token-delta, embedding-drift, and a composite score. 3) Verdicts produced by the harness match manual review on a holdout of 50 prompts 90% of the time. 4) Generated artifacts (report, diffs, seeds) are stored and linked in the job output. 5) GitHub PRs with quant artifacts are blocked if verdict=FAIL.
milestones: M2: Golden prompt selection + annotation tool (in progress)
M3: Harness prototype that runs single-model comparisons (next)
M4: CI integration and gating enforcement (follow-up)
test_plan: Run harness against fp32 baseline vs INT8 quant of t5-ish model using 200 golden prompts and verify composite score behavior.
Inject synthetic perturbations (token dropout, synonym swaps) to validate sensitivity and false-positive rate.
Run A/B with human raters on a 50-prompt subset to validate alignment with human judgment.
Smoke test CI gating by opening a PR with a known-bad quant artifact and asserting the status check fails.
metrics: token_delta_mean: mean absolute token-level edit distance between baseline and quant outputs
embedding_cosine_drift: mean cosine distance of sentence embeddings (min-mean-max)
logprob_kl: symmetric KL between token logprob distributions
composite_score: weighted aggregate (default weights: token_delta 0.4, embed_drift 0.4, logprob_kl 0.2)
ci_runtime_p50/p90: harness runtime percentiles in CI
gating_rules: WARN: composite_score between 0.03 and 0.07 OR embedding_cosine_drift between 0.05 and 0.12
FAIL: composite_score > 0.07 OR embedding_cosine_drift >= 0.12 OR safety_check_triggered
integration_points: CI: GitHub Actions job that invokes harness and publishes status check
Canary controller: read verdicts to block rollout if FAIL
Observability: upload per-prompt traces to Console under project=quantization-quality
notes: We will reuse the existing eval runner infra where possible but introduce deterministic seeding and tighter timeout handling for quant runs.
Consider using MTEB-style embeddings for cross-model embedding drift comparisons to keep behavior consistent across architectures.
Edge case: hallucination differences on open-ended prompts require a separate safety checklist — add a safety_check hook that runs targeted safety prompts.
